The visual spec anticipates "~96–104px at 1440," treating it as a range, but the declared clamp's 104px cap is unachievable with this chassis. Resolve by either: (a) revising hero_scale to clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) to match source-serif-text's actual output, (b) switching to a louder chassis (big-shoulders-atkinson, alfa-rubik, or dm-serif-public all reach 177px at 1440, providing headroom above the 104px target), or (c) updating the visual spec from "~96–104px" to "~96px anchored" and documenting the constraint.

- **Check 2: Preset–spec semantic token naming mismatch** — Visual spec names text colors as "primary" / "secondary" / "muted," but preset.ts defines them as "text" / "textMuted" / "textFaint." All hex values are correct (#1F1305, #513313, #71491A), so rendering will work, but vocabulary divergence risks implementation confusion in handoff. Rename preset.ts semantic tokens to align with spec language, or update visual spec to reference actual token names (text, textMuted, textFaint).

The signals should be denser, larger, more visible in the rings.
